description: This file defines the exported API functions for the HTTP Form Content Object module, including factory creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization functions.

methods.name: HttpCreateFormContent
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new form content object.

methods.name: HttpFcoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP Form Content Object.

methods.name: HttpFcoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified HTTP form content object.

methods.name: HttpFcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls all sub-objects required by the HTTP Form Content Object.

methods.name: HttpFcoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP Form Content Object.
